notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.
Simic Ragworm and Accomplished Alchemist are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Simic Ragworm.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
